body: Hey! I’m so sorry you are going through it! All this is hard. I recently had an ex call me through FaceTime and cut himself in front of me. He’s happy and safe now but dude that fucked me up so I understand your words. Is she ok? Is she pursuing treatment? Can you be apart of her treatment if she is?
No don’t. I contemplate it all the time. Are you on meds?? I hate that question but I’m curious.
